definitions.gloss: examination admission ticket; exam entry pass
definitions.explanation: A document that a test-taker must bring to be admitted to an examination. It typically includes the candidate's name, photo, exam number, and venue information.

examples.japanese: {受験票|じゅけんひょう}を{忘|わす}れないでください。
examples.english: Please don't forget your exam admission ticket.

examples.japanese: {受験票|じゅけんひょう}が{届|とど}いたので、いよいよ{本番|ほんばん}だと{実感|じっかん}した。
examples.english: My exam ticket arrived, and it finally felt real that the exam was approaching.

examples.japanese: {当日|とうじつ}は{受験票|じゅけんひょう}と{写真付|しゃしんつ}きの{身分証明書|みぶんしょうめいしょ}を{持参|じさん}してください。
examples.english: On the day, please bring your exam admission ticket and a photo ID.

notes:
Composed of {受験|じゅけん} (taking an exam) + {票|ひょう} (slip, ticket, ballot). An essential document for anyone sitting a formal examination in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {受験票|じゅけんひょう}を{持参|じさん}する (to bring one's exam ticket)
- {受験票|じゅけんひょう}が{届|とど}く (for the exam ticket to arrive)
- {受験票|じゅけんひょう}を{印刷|いんさつ}する (to print one's exam ticket)
- {受験票|じゅけんひょう}を{紛失|ふんしつ}する (to lose one's exam ticket)
- {受験票|じゅけんひょう}に{写真|しゃしん}を{貼|は}る (to affix a photo to one's exam ticket)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {受験番号|じゅけんばんごう} — exam number; the unique identification number printed on the ticket
- {入場券|にゅうじょうけん} — admission ticket; for general entry to venues, not exams

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, forgetting one's {受験票|じゅけんひょう} on exam day is a well-known source of panic. During major exam seasons ({入試|にゅうし}), news programs often feature stories of students who forgot their tickets and the efforts made to accommodate them.
